children: Cloud infrastructure company E2E Networks Ltd on Monday (August 31) said it has entered into a binding term sheet with a sovereign artificial intelligence (AI) company based in India for providing NVIDIA Blackwell cloud graphics processing units (GPUs) and allied services.

The arrangement has an aggregate contract value of approximately ₹1,000 crore, excluding applicable taxes, and remains valid until June 2029. The company said the engagement is a significant milestone in its strategy of signing up longer-term customers.

"....we wish to inform you that the company has entered into the binding term sheet with a Sovereign AI company based in India requiring high-performance computing infrastructure, for the provision of NVIDIA Blackwell cloud GPUs and allied services.
The arrangement has an aggregate contract value of approximately ₹1,000 crore (exclusive of applicable taxes) and remains valid up to June, 2029," according to a stock exchange filing.

Under the term sheet, E2E Networks will provide long-term AI infrastructure comprising cloud GPUs and allied services. The customer is a domestic entity, and the services are to be provided up to June 2029.
E2E Networks said the sovereign AI company has no relationship with the company’s promoter, promoter group or group companies. The contract does not fall under related-party transactions.
Shares of E2E Networks Ltd ended at ₹618.75, up by ₹1.85, or 0.30%, on the BSE.

title: E2E Networks bags ₹1,000 crore term sheet from sovereign AI company for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
